raw_note_release_semantics: Raw MIDI note-off, no pedal extension is performed by midi.read
source_caveat: Performed gates include authored feeling changes; these are not a reconstruction of acoustic sustain or actual force/key action
interpretation: Note-off durations are explicit source data; pedal/acoustic intent and physical release policy are not established by absent CC64. Preserve the ledger while distinguishing future physically authored key actions and damper sustain. Ten distinct pitches is a diagnostic threshold, not a complete geometric playability proof.
